posts.author: SkellyJack
posts.body:
Hey all,
I decided to revisit RPG Maker VX Ace since I’m not really in a position to upgrade to the newer engines right now. I’ve been going through different resources, and I was really hoping to find some modern-style overworld tilesets. I can’t seem to find any at all.
I don’t mind paying for them. I know people often assume users are only looking for free assets, but that’s not the case for me. I just want to find a good source, and so far I haven’t come across anything. Any guidance would be appreciated, paid or not!

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
I have some modern bits:
[Necromancy at work]Averys Ace-Stuff
Since it gained too much VX/Ace Stuff, I decided to create a thread to sepreate them.   You may use them as long as you credit Avery. If your project is commercial, you must send me a free copy. Don't repost them, if you want to share them, link to this thread.   Edit only for own purpose; no...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Avadan as well:
Avadan’s Resources
Avadan has great steampunk sprites, modern world map tiles, and an assortment of interesting sprites. His materials were posted on RPGMakerVX.net for six years without concern until some recent inf…

Bougainvillea has some stuff on mapchip 3
